snippet.textDisplay:
I’m so tired of the “good loss” mentality. Stop giving teams a boost for failing against an assumed higher strength of opponent, especially when it’s basically determined by some reporters that don’t even look into most of the games let alone watch. These P4 games are largely “any given Saturday”, even more so with programs figuring out how to use NIL best in their programs. 

I respect the SOS, but a 3-loss team shouldn’t be in because of that. It’s just assuming they’re a better team than a 10-2 team, instead of that P4 10-2 team being more successful than a P4 9-3 team. Give the P4 teams that showed up for the W the recognition. Those P4 players can only play their schedule. 

24 game playoff should then open it up to more G6 11-1 and 10-2 teams instead of just adding P4 9-3 and 8-4 teams. Sure, G6 will likely continue to get beat hard by P4, but give them the respect for their success over another team for their failures.
